views.front: The blue and white brick display car retains four wheels, wing and a distinct car silhouette.
views.rear: The rear wing, stepped brick body and rear wheels remain attached to the chassis.
views.detail: Brick studs, layered panels and the open window frame read as intentional toy construction.
